def transform(grid):
    # Split the canvas into the 8-shape and two markers; pair marker positions
    # encode the two horizontal translations of the shape.
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==4]
    # Marker columns specify translation offsets, while their row order selects
    # copies placed side by side. Demos establish displacement as marker col delta.
    d=abs(marks[0][1]-marks[1][1])
    h=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; w=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[[0]*(w+d) for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in shape:
        out[r][c]=8
        out[r][c+d]=8
    return out
PY
